name: partial_objects_after_failed_script
source: audit F11 shape: a script creates Shell and Lid and then dies on its last line; the old pipeline left both objects behind, the retry created 'Shell001' / 'Lid001' and the model built on the duplicates.
prompt: make a box with a lid, 60 x 40 x 20 mm

args.code:
import FreeCAD as App
import Part
d = App.getDocument('{doc}')
shell = d.addObject('Part::Box', 'Shell')
shell.Length = 60
shell.Width = 40
shell.Height = 20
lid = d.addObject('Part::Box', 'Lid')
lid.Length = 60
lid.Width = 40
lid.Height = 3
d.recompute()
raise RuntimeError('lip does not fit the shell')

rounds.note: the same script without the bad line

args.code:
